The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download JIPMER Job 2026 Notification PDF

rows.event: Last date for sending complete applications by email

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for JIPMER Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support - III and Fieldworker posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies. One post is for Project Technical Support - III, and the remaining four are for Project Technical Support - I / Fieldworker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support - III?
faq.answer: For Project Technical Support - III, candidates need a Master's degree in Public Health, Public Health Nursing, MSc in Public Health Nursing, or MSW with relevant research experience and at least one year of experience in community-level projects.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support - I / Fieldworker?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Technical Support - I / Fieldworker is 30 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Project Technical Support - III will receive Rs. 33,040 per month plus TA. Project Technical Support - I / Fieldworker will receive Rs. 21,240 per month plus TA.

faq.question: Q6. How should candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates need to send their filled application form, CV, and supporting documents as a single PDF via email to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a written test, a skill test, and an interview. Candidates must perform well in all stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for these posts. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Puducherry apply?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any geographical restrictions for applicants. However, candidates should ensure they meet all other eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their CV and scanned copies of all supporting documents, including educational certificates and experience certificates, in a single PDF file.
